eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Summit, UT; at 12:25 PM on AUG 10, 2026 Effective until 1:25 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The area south of Franklin Canyon to Icy Springs/Wohali Way is in SET status for possible evacuation from the Rocky Canyon Fire. Be prepared to leave at a moment's notice. This is NOT an evacuation order. Load your vehicle with your go bag and essentials. Please do not call 911 for updates. Continue to monitor for official information available at www.dsummitcounty.info/emergency and Utah Fire Info.
